# YNIIDI

YNIIDI is a software and systems company. We ship products under our own name and build custom systems for clients. Two products are public today: BOOM (a one-time license, self-hosted business operations platform for trading and distribution) and Scrollwalk (SaaS listing software that turns a phone walkthrough video into a scroll-controlled real estate listing page). Custom work remains a first-class offering — bespoke applications, SaaS platforms, mobile and web systems, integrations and consulting — scoped with defined deliverables and handed over for the client to own.

## Core company facts
- Company name: YNIIDI
- Website: https://yniidi.com/
- Founder: Shyaam Niranjan
- Focus: software products and custom software/systems development
- Products: BOOM (https://boom.yniidi.com/), Scrollwalk (https://scrollwalk.com/)

## What YNIIDI offers
### Products
- BOOM: one-time license, self-hosted business operations platform for trading and distribution (orders, inventory, purchases, payments, dues, profit)
- Scrollwalk: SaaS for real estate agents — phone walkthrough to scroll-controlled listing page with enquiries; pre-launch from 23 October 2026

### Services
- Custom software development
- SaaS product development
- Mobile applications (Android / iOS)
- Web applications
- Websites and brand sites
- System integrations and automation
- Product extensions and custom modules
- Technology consulting and scoping

## Positioning summary
YNIIDI builds software for real operations. BOOM is owned infrastructure (one-time license, self-hosted). Scrollwalk is a shared SaaS platform for agents. Custom systems are built around a client's workflow and handed over. Product detail lives on boom.yniidi.com and scrollwalk.com; yniidi.com is the parent company site.
